    China East Education Holdings Limited (the “Company”) and its         中國東方教育控股有限公司（「本公司」）及
    subsidiaries (collectively, the “Group”) are a leading provider in    其附屬公司（統稱「本集團」）為中國領先職
    the vocational training education in China. Our business focuses      業技能教育提供商。我們的業務集中在為
    on providing innovative vocational training education to students     學生提供創新性職業技能教育，從而提高
    to increase their employability in the ever-changing employment       學生在不斷變化的就業市場中的就業能
    market, as well as supporting China’s evolving workforce              力，並支持因中國持續的經濟增長，城鎮
    requirements driven by its sustained economic growth, urbanization    化及產業升級而帶來的不斷變化的勞動力
    and industrial upgrade.                                               需求。

    sectors, namely, culinary arts, information technology and internet   域，即烹飪技術、信息技術及互聯網技

for the year ended 31 December 2021.                                    年度之年度報告。


OVERVIEW                                                                概述

Year 2021 is a year in which the Group responded positively and         2021年是本集團積極應變、堅持高質量發
adhered to high-quality development. The Group endeavoured              展的一年。集團上下努力克服疫情影響，
at all levels to overcome the impact of the pandemic by focusing        緊盯年度目標任務，積極應對機遇和挑
on the goal of the year, actively responding to opportunities and       戰，各項戰略部署得到有力貫徹執行，經
challenges and effectively implementing various strategic plans,        營發展保持穩健，取得了良好經濟效益與
thereby maintaining a steady business development and achieving         社會效益。
favorable economic and social benefits.

1.   For the year ended 31 December 2021, with the Group’s              1.   截至2021年12月31日止年度，本集

     educational facilities to prevent incidents that endanger personal     的檢查，預防危及人身安全的事件發生，
     safety and also ensure a safe and healthy learning environment. At     確保提供一個安全健康的學習環境。同
     the same time, we strive to build a respectful campus, respecting      時，我們努力營造充滿尊重的校園，尊重
     the dignity, honor and privacy of students.                            學生的人格尊嚴、榮譽權、隱私權等。


     We establish independent files for students and parents, and           我們為學生和家長建立獨立的檔案，並對
     impose strict regulations on the protection of personal information    檔案的個人資訊保護及機密管理做出嚴格
     and confidential management of files. We have established post         的規定。我們建立崗位保密協定及《資訊資
     confidentiality agreement and the “Information Confidentiality         料保密制度》，員工入職時必須簽訂崗位保
     System”, and employees must sign the post confidentiality              密協議；學生及家長資料資訊匯總進入管
     agreement when they are onboard. After the information of student      理系統後，僅當得到校級管理人員授權後
     and parent is collected and processed into the management              方可查看。
     system, it can only be viewed with the authorization of the school

     3.1.2 Safeguarding Students’ Rights and Interests in Receiving         3.1.2 維護學生受教育權益

has replaced the foreign investment legal foundation in the PRC          行。《外商投資法》取代中國目前由三項法

27. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                           27. 資本風險管理

    The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in            本集團管理其資本以確保本集團實體
    the Group will be able to continue as a going concern               能夠持續經營，同時通過優化債務與
    while maximising the return to shareholders through the             股本間的平衡為股東帶來最大回報。
    optimisation of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s            本集團的整體戰略由往年起保持不
    overall strategy remains unchanged from prior year.                 變。


    The capital structure of the Group consists of equity               本集團的資本結構包括綜合權益變動
    attributable to owners of the Group, issued share capital,          表所披露的本集團擁有人應佔權益、
    retained profits and other reserves as disclosed in the             已發行股本及留存溢利及其他儲備。
    consolidated statement of changes in equity.


    The directors of the Company review the capital structure           本公司董事每半年檢討資本結構。作
    on a semi-annual basis. As part of this review, the directors       為檢討的一部分，董事考慮資本成本
    consider the cost of capital and the risks associated with          及與各類資本相關的風險。根據董事
    each class of capital. Based on recommendations of the              的推薦意見，本集團將通過派付股
    directors, the Group will balance its overall capital structure     息、發行新股及回購股份以及發行新
    through the payment of dividends, new share issues and              債或贖回現有債務以平衡其整體資本
    share buy-backs as well as the issue of new debt or the             結構。
    redemption of existing debt.

33. RETIREMENT BENEFITS SCHEMES                                     33. 退休福利計劃

   The employees of the PRC subsidiaries are members of the           中國附屬公司的僱員為由中國政府運
   state-management retirement benefits scheme operated by            作受國家管理的退休福利計劃成員。
   the PRC government. The Group is required to contribute            本集團須將薪酬開支按各地方政府機
   a specified percentage of payroll costs as determined by           關制定的比例向退休福利計劃作出供
   respective local government authority to the retirement            款，以為福利提供資金。本集團有關
   benefits scheme to fund the benefits. The only obligation of       退休福利計劃的唯一責任是根據計劃
   the Group with respect to the retirement benefits scheme is        作出規定的供款。
   to make the specified contribution under the scheme.


   The Group also operates a Mandatory Provident Fund                 本集團為所有香港僱員均參與強制性
   Scheme for all employees in Hong Kong. The assets of the           公積金計劃。該計劃的資產與本集團
   scheme are held separately from those of the Group, in funds       的資產分開持有，並由獨立信託人控
   under the control of trustees. The Group contributes a certain     制的基金管理。本集團及僱員在該計
   percentage of the relevant payroll costs to the scheme, which      劃下都須按相關薪金成本若干百分比
   contribution is matched by the employees.                          供款。


   The amounts of contributions made by the Group in respect          本集團於兩個年度內就退休福利計劃
   of the retirement benefit schemes during both years are            作出的供款金額披露於附註11及12。
   disclosed in notes 11 and 12.
